title: Certified Arbitrary-Precision Evaluation of a Family of Generalized Multiple Zeta Functions
summary: We describe a certified arbitrary-precision framework for evaluating a family of generalized multiple zeta functions. The family includes strict and weak-star chain sums, ordinary and colored multiple zeta values, affine-base and polynomial-base variants, and composite levels containing several affine or polynomial letters with complex coefficients. The numerical strategy combines finite-prefix recurrences with two complementary analytic-tail mechanisms: recursive Euler-Maclaurin expansion of one-variable tails and direct absolute tail majorants.
